# Section 1: Overview

# Purpose
The purpose of this document is to bring reliability in the UI specifically with Advance Export incentive handling.

# Business Requirement
Certainly, in order to make the UI more interactive and efficient with regards to Advance Export Incentive handling.

# Scope
The Scope of these specs is to enhance the below screens:-
• Sales invoice
• Export Incentive
• Duty Script movement

# Section 2. Assumptions
• No Assumptions

# Section 3. Functional Requirement Description

# ADVANCE INCENTIVE HANDELLING

### Screen 01 | ASN List screen
PATH : Sales >> ASN >> List
Problem Statement:
Currently in system, In order to book a License sale invoice based on the ROSLCTL incentive details, only the posted sales invoices carrying such incentive information be processed. However the sales invoice posting is subject to the goods delivery which sometime can takes more than usual time which stretchs the time gap between the ASN and its invoice creation . Wherein the incentive details are already received by us and requried to book an Advacne license sale. So we need a provision to put the incentive details at the ASN level and proceed for the script movement and licenvese sale on the basis of that with certain ledger level consideration as detailed below.
Required Changes:-
• There will be hyperlink at each line/ASN level which will provide user a pop-up “Incentive detail”. This pop-up will have same input-fields for Incentive level detail as it works while sales invoice creation level.
• This incentive attached information should get auto-fetched while creatiing invoice of this sale incentive
• This incentive details should be made available in all the ASN/incentive related SPs.
• This column be enabled through Screen layout configurator, along with the muliple column headers
• Incentive information can be attached only to the confirmed ASNs.

### Screen 02 | Duty Script Movement Sheet
FA >> AR >> Duty Script Movement
Problem Statement :-
Currently, Duty script movement details can only be attached for the posted sales invoice which restricts us to approch the advance incentive based script sales.
So following to the SCREEN 01 wherein the incentive details information have already been attached to its respective ASN, that ASN should become visible on this screen as well for the script movement processeing.
No other change in the functionality
Required Changes :-
• As soon as the incentive information is updated at the ASN level, then that ASN
will list in the incentive Pending tab.
• All the columns in the tab will be functioning the infomration at ASN level. Information for whichever column is not in the ASN will be reflected in the column likewise.
• Information related to which Incentive have been raised on the basis of ASN and which have been raised on the basis of invoice need to be stored and provided for reporting purposes.
• No other change with the movement functionality.

### Screen 03 | Non Stock Sales and Voucher posting
User Story :-
The license recorded above, should be available to license sale.
Also on there is certain voucher posting level changes required as detailed below:-
PATH : FA >> AR >> Non-stock Sales >> License sales
Required Changes :-
• At the time of license sale invoice posting, system should check that the linked invoice is via ASN or not and should trigger an Auto-Income Reversal entry from a liablity ledger to the ROSLCTL income ledger, as below :-
• In case, against ASN, not invoiced

[TABLE 1: Table 1 · 3 rows · columns: Party (text), Dr (text), 50 (integer)]
| Party | Dr | 50 |
| Sale of Licence | Cr | 50 |
| ROSLCTL1 | Dr | 50 |
| ROSCTL (Recoverable) | Cr | 50 |
• In case, Invoice Posted.

[TABLE 2: Table 2 · 2 rows · columns: ROSLCTL1 (text), DR (text), 50 (integer)]
| ROSLCTL1 | DR | 50 |
| Loss on Sale of Duty Script | DR | 50 |
| ROSLCTL1 (Recoverable) | CR | 100 |

### Screen 03 | Multiple Voucher Posting level changes
Required Changes :-
• With refer to above case, At the time of sale invoice posting, there should be an Auto-income recognisation entry, as below:-

[TABLE 3: Table 3 · 2 rows · columns: ROSCTL (text), DR (text), 50 (integer)]
| ROSCTL | DR | 50 |
| Loss on Sale of Duty Script | DR | 50 |
| ROSLCTL1 (Recoverable) | CR | 100 |
• Advance reciept agaisn the DBK (next screen)

### Screen 04 | Export Incentive
FA >> AR >> Export Incentive >> New
Problem Statement :-
• Currently, sales incentive outstanding documents screen, details can only be processed for the posted sales invoice which restricts us to approch the advance incentive recipts.
• So following to the SCREEN 01 wherein the incentive details information have already been attached to its respective sales ASN, should also become visible on this screen as well for the advance receipts processeing.
• it will be of full amount, no adjustment allowed.
• No other change in the functionality

# Section 4. Glossary
• No Glossary
